### Overview:
The Cloud Run revision `priemok-skai-iuokl-00026-xt8` is failing to start because the container is unable to mount the specified Google Cloud Storage bucket `ai-studio-bucket-573947254852-us-west1`. This is directly indicated by the "volume: mount operation failed" error in the logs. The service account `573947254852-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com`, which is associated with your Cloud Run service, lacks the necessary `storage.objects.list` permission to access the GCS bucket. This permission issue prevents the application from initializing correctly, leading to its termination and subsequent health check failures on port 8080. I ran `gcloud run revisions describe priemok-skai-iuokl-00026-xt8 --region us-west1` and found that the revision's `Ready` and `ContainerHealthy` conditions are `False` with the reason `HealthCheckContainerError`, indicating the container failed to start and listen on port 8080. I also ran `gcloud logging read resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.revision_name="priemok-skai-iuokl-00026-xt8" AND severity>="ERROR"` and found logs explicitly stating "volume: mount operation failed" and "PermissionDenied" errors related to `storage.objects.list`.
### Recommended fixes:
*   Grant the Cloud Run service account the `Storage Object Viewer` role on the GCS bucket `ai-studio-bucket-573947254852-us-west1`. You can do this using the `gcloud` command:
    `gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://ai-studio-bucket-573947254852-us-west1 --member=serviceAccount:573947254852-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer`.
*   After granting the permissions, deploy a new revision of your Cloud Run service to pick up the updated permissions.

### Kaip dabar paleisti programą:

Kadangi matote „It's running!“ puslapį, jūs jau turite veikiančią „Google Cloud“ aplinką. Norėdami įdiegti savo kodą vietoje pavyzdžio, atlikite šiuos veiksmus savo terminale (Google Cloud Shell):

1.  Įsitikinkite, kad esate projekto aplanke, kuriame yra šie nauji failai.
2.  Paleiskite komandą:
    ```bash
    gcloud run deploy hello --source . --region europe-west1 --allow-unauthenticated
    ```
    *(Pavadinimą `hello` galite pakeisti į kokį norite, pvz., `priemokos`)*.

**Kodėl tai padės?**
